name: Neobohaiornis
sum: Small adult bohaiornithid from the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning described in 2024.
wsnote: About 47 g estimated from a 25 mm humerus (Shen et al. 2024, via Wikipedia).
holotype: A well-preserved, probably fully grown skeleton with feather impressions (number in Shen et al. 2024).
biology: Most compound bones are fused, so the individual was probably fully grown.
author: Shen et al. 2024
